svg.title: PokéTeam Builder: website wireframes
svg.text: Low-fidelity page layouts for docs/Website_Plan.md · 2026-11-14 · Example data comes from the real tables; trainers and teams are made up.

g.text: Click a name → Pokémon page. The type filter matches type1 OR type2.
On 3 trainers' teams: Ash, Misty, Brock
Click an ability → ability page. Click a trainer → their team.
Query: POKEMON ⋈ POKEMON_ABILITY ⋈ ABILITY, plus COUNT over PARTY_MEMBER.
Click a name → Pokémon page. Query: ABILITY ⋈ POKEMON_ABILITY ⋈ POKEMON.
Create → INSERT INTO TRAINER, then go to that trainer's team page.
Duplicate name → "That trainer name is taken (R4)".
A new trainer starts with an empty team (R5 allows 0).
Query: TRAINER LEFT JOIN PARTY_MEMBER … GROUP BY trainer.
✕ That Pokémon is already on this team (R6). Nothing was saved.
Ability list = only that Pokémon's abilities (R7).
The nav bar on every page links to Pokédex and Trainers.
notes for us, not shown on the real site
• "Try to break it" button on the team builder • Stats page • Sprites
